global_style: Elegant minimalist presentation featuring continuous fluid line motifs, stark geometric image masks, and a sophisticated mustard and grey color palette.

identity_anchors: Continuous, fluid accent lines intersecting with rigid layouts
Diagonal and triangular geometric image masking
Persistent vertical text elements on the right margin
Combination of elegant serif headers with modern sans-serif body text
Desaturated or greyscale imagery paired with a single vibrant accent color

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
